packageRules.description: slsa-github-generator MUST be referenced by an exact @vX.Y.Z tag, never a digest: its README states the generators 'MUST be referenced by tag in order for the slsa-verifier to be able to verify the ref of the trusted builder' (hash-pinned reusable workflows are unsupported, slsa-verifier#12). ADR-1128's Release Script Contract enforces the tag form, so a digest-pin PR (#1183) can never pass it. Keep tag updates, forbid digest pinning.

Intel NEO stack moves as a matched set: dev/Containerfile downloads intel-igdgmm12_${GMMLIB_VER} and the IGC debs from the intel/compute-runtime release page for NEO_VER, so a lone gmmlib/IGC bump yields a 404 (PR #1184). Group all four into ONE PR; still manual review (ADR-0605).
Group GitHub Actions minor+patch+digest bumps; auto-merge — digest-only is mechanical and CI catches drift.
Major Action upgrades require human review — breaking changes possible.
Group pre-commit hook rev bumps; auto-merge — mechanical, lint catches drift.
Python patch updates auto-merge; minor + major need review.
Keep the tool-only root Python floor at minor-series granularity so Dependabot's updater image can satisfy it; workflow runtime pins still receive patch updates.

Group numpy across ALL managers (pep621 + pip_requirements + setuptools/setup.py) into ONE PR. numpy is pinned in ai/, mcp-server/, python/, ensemble-kit/, roi-score/ via a mix of pyproject.toml, setup.py and requirements*.txt, so the per-manager Python groups split a single numpy bump into two PRs (e.g. #1040 pep621/setup.py + #1041 pip_requirements). This package rule overrides the group for numpy so future bumps land together. Minor needs review (NaN/dtype ABI risk in the DNN + AI stack).
Group all Go minor + patch updates into one PR; auto-merge. k8s/grpc/proto patch bumps are low-risk; CI gates catch regressions.
Go major upgrades travel individually and require human review — module path and API changes.
Group all Cargo (Rust) minor + patch updates; auto-merge — Rust's semantic versioning is reliable and CI catches UB/breakage.
Cargo major upgrades require human review — breaking API changes, unsafe code review.

Batch every Docker base-image digest/pin refresh into one PR. Ungrouped, each image (debian, fedora, ubuntu, golang, archlinux, python, both distroless variants, docker/dockerfile, otel-collector, nvidia/cuda) opened its own PR and its own full CI matrix run; on 2026-08-30 that fan-out starved the Required Checks Aggregator so no dependency PR could merge at all.
Renovate's own action — manual review on bumps to retain auditability of the dep-bot itself.
FFmpeg release tag — manual review; drives the ffmpeg-patches/ rebase story.
ROCm apt-repo version bump — manual review required. ROCm major-version bumps carry KFD ioctl ABI risk; validate kernel compat before merging (ADR-0604, ADR-0603).

dev-image deps (CUDA-adjacent, Intel NEO/IGC/gmmlib/LZ0, ONNX Runtime, SVT-AV1, VVenC, AMF) — manual review required. Container rebuild has large blast radius; validate GPU compatibility before merging. See ADR-0605.

customManagers.description: FFmpeg release tag pinned in the patch-stack test script + the CI gate + the Containerfile ARG.
ROCm pin in dev/Containerfile. Matches both the ARG ROCM_VER line and the repo URL path so both stay in sync on bumps. Queries the AMD apt directory listing via the html datasource. See ADR-0604.
Intel compute-runtime (NEO) version in dev/Containerfile. Tracks github.com/intel/compute-runtime releases. See ADR-0605.

Intel Graphics Compiler (IGC) version in dev/Containerfile. Extracts the semver portion before the '+<build-id>' suffix (e.g. 2.34.4 from 2.34.4+21428). The +build suffix is Intel's internal build counter — it stays in the ARG line after Renovate bumps the semver part; a reviewer should update it to match the new release's counter. Tracks github.com/intel/intel-graphics-compiler releases. See ADR-0605.
Intel gmmlib (Graphics Memory Management) version in dev/Containerfile. Tracks github.com/intel/gmmlib releases. See ADR-0605.
Level Zero loader version in dev/Containerfile. Tracks github.com/oneapi-src/level-zero releases. See ADR-0605.
ONNX Runtime C++ library version in dev/Containerfile. Installed via tarball from GitHub releases (not apt). Tracks github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime releases. See ADR-0605.
SVT-AV1 encoder version in dev/Containerfile. Built from source via git clone of gitlab.com/AOMediaCodec/SVT-AV1 at a tagged release. See ADR-0605.
VVenC (Fraunhofer VVC reference encoder) version in dev/Containerfile. Built from source via git clone of github.com/fraunhoferhhi/vvenc at a tagged release. See ADR-0605.
AMD AMF (Advanced Media Framework) headers version in dev/Containerfile. Built from source via git clone of github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/AMF at a tagged release. See ADR-0605.
